legacy_rtl_policy: A sole supported receiver can initialize validated empty setup while preserving registration and general settings. Receiver-bound calibration and hardware settings never transfer to different or ambiguous hardware; scan-plan saves retain identity-swap protection.

qualification.scope: Exact complete installer on the registered owned RTL bench: repeat installation, preserved node-owned state, authenticated check-ins and new real RF reports before and after actual reboot, and three sustained samples across all seven configured windows with no new receiver errors.
qualification.limits: The signed canonical run begins on already-installed Build315/updater1.0.89. Earlier updater replacement facts and registered-empty adoption/identity-swap regression fixtures remain separate; this is not a signed forward-upgrade or physical empty-receiver-start attestation. Other receiver families, every-band audio and known-station accuracy are not asserted.
